content: Two-pass onboarding (community guides frankper/the-one-nix, HALLway, pvv-nixos-config, unmovedcentre - MEDIUM): chicken-and-egg - host age key must exist before sops can decrypt, but generateKey only creates it at first activation. Canonical sequence: (1) deploy config with secrets disabled/placeholder or encrypted for admin only; (2) generate host age key on the target itself (age-keygen on host, private key never leaves; or ssh-to-age from ssh_host_ed25519_key for NixOS); (3) register host public key as anchor in .sops.yaml keys: and add to creation_rules; (4) run sops updatekeys from a machine holding the admin key; (5) commit, re-deploy. Failure signature: 'sops-install-secrets: failed to decrypt ... Error getting data key: 0 successful groups required' = key not registered in .sops.yaml or not in creation_rules or secrets not rekeyed. Standalone HM reads key from ~/.config/sops/age/keys.txt; NixOS system module from /var/lib/sops-nix/key.txt (or /var/lib/sops/age/keys.txt); wrong path per platform = cannot decrypt.
